items.title: Daryl Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2024
items.q: every time I’d come I’d have Warren Vache or maybe — oh Loren Schoenberg and some — Joe Cohn and all different people for him, Dan Barrett, and he loved that.

ctx.x: Well this has been a wonderful conversation, and I make an observation that your father, who did get to hear you, must be very proud. He was proud and he probably still is.

Oh, I hope so. I hope so. He’s up there. Just before he died, bless their hearts, the Arbors people released a recording of live performances at my hometown jazz emporium, Chan’s, through a few years when he was actually at his best on the trombone, and every time I’d come I’d have Warren Vache or maybe — oh Loren Schoenberg and some — Joe Cohn and all different people for him, Dan Barrett, and he loved that. And so it became an album and it’s still out there. On his birthday the year after he died I was playing…
Well I hope you have a wonderful gig this afternoon and I’m going to put in a request for “Once in a While.”
